checklist.title: Get started
checklist.empty: No setup steps available right now.
checklist.dismissedMessage: Remove this widget from your dashboard or restart the checklist to see your remaining setup steps.
checklist.help: Tracks the few things you need to configure before TeslaSync feels useful. Auto-completes each step as you do it; dismiss it once you're done.

settings.title: Setup Checklist
settings.description: Restart the first-run checklist widget on your dashboard. If you removed it, re-add the “Setup Checklist” widget from the dashboard customizer.
settings.restarted: Setup checklist restarted — re-add the widget from the dashboard customizer if needed.

connectVehicle.title: Connect your Tesla
connectVehicle.description: Link your Tesla account to start syncing data.

pickTheme.title: Pick a theme
pickTheme.description: Choose an accent color that fits your style.

firstAlert.title: Create your first alert rule
firstAlert.description: Get notified when something changes — battery low, charge complete, etc.

notify.title: Add a notification channel
notify.description: Without a channel (Discord, ntfy, email, …) your alerts go to /dev/null.

commandPalette.title: Try the command palette
commandPalette.description: Press Ctrl+K (or ⌘K) to jump anywhere instantly.

enablePush.title: Enable web push notifications
enablePush.description: Get alerts in your browser even when TeslaSync is closed.

customizeDashboard.title: Customize your dashboard
customizeDashboard.description: Add widgets that match how you use TeslaSync.
